observation: The FP16 control reproduces the known symptom: blue-white face-obscuring glow at frames32-35, recurring red/cyan/green/white luminous patches on helmet, suit and background. Direct inspection of all124 frames from each decoder shows the same material artifacts at the same temporal/spatial locations in FP32, including face32-35 and final green helmet glow123. Minor pixel/detail differences are visible but neither output meets the existing content rule. Both retain recognizable person/scene and head motion.
conclusion: FP32 decoder arithmetic alone does not fix the observed visual failure in this controlled actual same-latent case. This is negative causal evidence for the proposed precision-only fix, not proof of the exact remaining cause. No canonical precision, checkpoint, oracle or readiness change.
